recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless a future build reactivates one of these legacy resource copies and reintroduces the misspelling.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care technical correction from the January 2015 ballot asking to replace "The clinicial performing the assessment" with "The clinician performing the assessment" for the Clinical Assessment/ClinicalImpression performer wording.
initial_application: The Jira resolution and comments cite svn revision 4401. Git commit 45e170c05d25c8fdbcce22dc6059e160bff251fd carries git-svn revision 4401 and changes the exact two clinicalassessment spreadsheet cells from "clinicial" to "clinician"; its subject says "#5342 - fix typo", but the revision and patch match FHIR-5324.
additional_context: The DSTU1 related URL was clinicalassessment.html. Later source history renamed ClinicalAssessment to ClinicalImpression and also retains ClinicalAssessment source copies. Current source/clinicalimpression and source/clinicalassessment definitions, search parameters, and event mapping exceptions all use the corrected "clinician" spelling. source/fhir.ini does not actively list either ClinicalImpression or ClinicalAssessment in the current [resources] list and only records that Clinical Assessment became ClinicalImpression.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested typo fix is already present and no current-build source edit is warranted.
